description: Texas county building footprints, 2018 is a data set deposited in Kinder Institute Urban Data Platform by its authors ESRI, Houston-Galveston Area Council. Building footprints in Galveston County, Texas, derived from LiDAR data. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2020. The repository holds 14 deposits of this kind (versions, parts or per-site or per-year releases); this record describes the series through its most recent member and lists the others in the notes. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository.
